brief_summary: An efficacy and safety study of ezetimibe (+) simvastatin compared to atorvastatin at week 6 in diabetics or metabolic syndrome patients in Korea.
brief_title: Ezetimibe (+) Simvastatin vs. Atorvastatin Comparative Study in DM or Metabolic Syndrome Patients (0653A-093)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of hypercholesterolemia
* Drug naive or statin treated but inadequately controlled patients against NCEP ATP III guideline goal

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hypersensitivity to HMG-CoA inhibitor or Ezetimibe

official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label Study to Evaluate the Lipid-Altering Efficacy and Safety of Ezetimibe (+) Simvastatin Versus Atorvastatin in Hypercholesterolemic Patients With Diabetes Mellitus or Metabolic Syndrome
